title: Intel Suffers Worst Day Since 1974 as Weak Outlook Triggers Chip Rout
en: Intel shares suffered their steepest one-day fall since 1974 on Friday, tumbling 28.58% after the chipmaker issued a far weaker-than-expected fourth-quarter outlook. Third-quarter revenue rose 21% to 16.51 billion dollars and adjusted profit came in at 52 cents a share, beating forecasts of 40 cents. But Intel projected fourth-quarter revenue of 15 billion to 16 billion dollars against analysts' average estimate of 17.07 billion, and adjusted profit of 25 cents versus 43 cents expected. Chief financial officer David Zinsner said personal-computer shipments could fall about 12% this year and that the company does not expect positive cash flow in 2026. The selloff dragged the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 7.2%, its biggest drop since June.
zh: 周五英特尔股价创下1974年以来最大单日跌幅，暴跌28.58%，原因是这家芯片制造商给出的四季度业绩指引远逊预期。三季度营收增长21%至165.1亿美元，调整后每股收益52美分，高于市场预期的40美分。但英特尔预计四季度营收为150亿至160亿美元，低于分析师平均预期的170.7亿美元；调整后每股收益预计25美分，而市场预期为43美分。首席财务官大卫·津斯纳表示，今年个人电脑出货量可能下降约12%，公司预计2026年不会产生正向现金流。这轮抛售拖累费城半导体指数下跌7.2%，为6月以来最大跌幅。

title: Bank of Japan Holds at 1.25%, Declares Inflation Has Reached 2% Goal
en: The Bank of Japan held its policy rate at 1.25% on Friday in an eight-to-one vote, but signalled a hawkish shift by declaring for the first time that underlying inflation has broadly reached its 2% price-stability target. It is the first such assessment since the target was set in 2013. Policymakers warned that they must pay special attention to the risk of inflation overshooting. The board also decided to accelerate sales of exchange-traded funds, raising the annual pace to about 860 billion yen from January and cutting the time needed to unload the holdings to roughly 43 years from about 112. Governor Kazuo Ueda said the bank will keep raising rates and adjusting the degree of monetary easing.
zh: 日本央行周五以8比1的投票结果将政策利率维持在1.25%不变，但释放鹰派信号——首次宣布基础通胀已大体达到2%的物价稳定目标。这是该行2013年设定该目标以来首次作出这一评估。政策制定者警告，必须特别关注通胀超调的风险。董事会还决定加快出售交易所交易基金，自明年1月起将年度出售规模提高至约8600亿日元，完成全部持仓出售所需时间由此前约112年缩短至约43年。行长植田和男表示，央行将继续上调利率并调整货币宽松的程度。
vocab: adj. 鹰派的；倾向收紧政策的

title: Hackers Drain $6.3 Billion From Binance in Largest Crypto Theft on Record
en: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, said hackers drained about 6.3 billion dollars of digital assets in what is believed to be the biggest crypto theft on record. The company described a complex attack and said it had frozen roughly 3 billion dollars of the affected funds with help from blockchain partners. An initial probe pointed to a compromised engineer's laptop, but a later investigation found additional points of breach. Blockchain firm TRM Labs said with high confidence that TraderTraitor, North Korea's elite hacking unit, was behind the raid, noting that an attacker moved about 6.36 billion dollars across ten blockchains, most of it within twenty minutes. Binance suspended withdrawals and pledged to cover all losses.
zh: 全球最大加密货币交易所币安表示，黑客盗走约63亿美元数字资产，这可能是有史以来规模最大的加密货币盗窃案。币安称这是一次“复杂攻击”，并表示已在区块链合作伙伴协助下冻结约30亿美元受影响资金。初步调查指向一名工程师的笔记本电脑被入侵，但后续调查发现了更多入侵点。区块链分析公司TRM Labs表示，高度确信朝鲜精锐黑客组织TraderTraitor策划了此次袭击，并指出攻击者跨10条区块链转移了约63.6亿美元，其中大部分在20分钟内完成。币安已暂停提现，并承诺承担全部损失。
vocab: adj. 被攻陷的；遭入侵的

title: Euro Zone Growth Beats Forecasts While German Inflation Cools to 2.8%
en: The euro zone economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter, with preliminary data showing gross domestic product up 0.4% on the quarter and 1.3% on the year, both beating forecasts. The wider European Union expanded 0.5% on the quarter. Performance was mixed: Germany and Spain grew, Italy was flat, and France unexpectedly contracted 0.1%. Separately, German inflation cooled to 2.8% in October from 3.3% in September as energy price rises slowed. European Central Bank officials warned that inflation risks remain tilted to the upside, and a fresh ECB survey suggested euro area inflation may not return to the bank's 2% target until 2028.
zh: 欧元区经济第三季度增速快于预期，初步数据显示国内生产总值环比增长0.4%、同比增长1.3%，均超出市场预期。整个欧盟环比增长0.5%。各成员国表现不一：德国和西班牙实现增长，意大利持平，法国则意外萎缩0.1%。另外，受能源价格涨幅放缓影响，德国10月通胀率由9月的3.3%回落至2.8%。欧洲央行多位官员警告，通胀风险仍偏向上行；该行最新调查显示，欧元区通胀率可能要到2028年才会回到央行2%的目标水平。

title: Trump Weighs Renewed Strikes on Iran Days After US Midterm Vote
en: President Donald Trump is preparing to resume military strikes on Iran as soon as November 4, the day after congressional midterm elections, three senior Gulf Arab officials said. Washington has told Gulf allies to get ready for a short, intense campaign aimed either at forcing Tehran back into a nuclear agreement or degrading its nuclear programme. Gulf governments are lobbying for de-escalation, fearing retaliation against their territory and energy infrastructure. The United States is sending a third aircraft carrier strike group, led by the USS Theodore Roosevelt, to the region with about 9,000 sailors and Marines aboard. Trump said the war would end very soon but insisted Iran must never obtain a nuclear weapon.
zh: 三名海湾国家高级官员称，特朗普总统准备最早于11月4日——即美国国会中期选举次日——恢复对伊朗的军事打击。华盛顿已告知海湾盟友做好准备，将发动一场短促而密集的军事行动，目的要么是迫使德黑兰重返核协议，要么是削弱其核计划。海湾国家政府正游说美方降级局势，担心本国领土和能源设施遭到报复。美国正向该地区派遣第三个航母打击群，由“西奥多·罗斯福”号率领，舰上约有9000名水兵和海军陆战队员。特朗普表示战争将很快结束，但坚称伊朗绝不能拥有核武器。
vocab: n. 航空母舰；运输工具

title: Amazon Cloud Growth Hits 39% but AI Spending Pushes Cash Flow Negative
en: Amazon reported third-quarter revenue of 201.94 billion dollars, up 12%, as its cloud unit accelerated for a sixth straight quarter. Amazon Web Services revenue rose 39% to 45.98 billion dollars, beating analysts' estimate of 38.2%, and the company said it expects growth above 40% in both 2027 and 2028. But the artificial intelligence infrastructure buildout came at a steep cost: purchases of property and equipment reached 77.26 billion dollars in the quarter, pushing free cash flow over the trailing twelve months to negative 42.4 billion dollars. Capital spending guidance for 2026 was held at 220 billion dollars. Chief executive Andy Jassy called AI a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
zh: 亚马逊公布三季度营收2019.44亿美元，同比增长12%，其云业务连续第六个季度加速增长。亚马逊云服务（AWS）营收增长39%至459.84亿美元，高于分析师38.2%的预期；公司称预计2027年和2028年增速都将超过40%。但人工智能基础设施的扩建代价高昂：当季购置物业设备支出达772.6亿美元，使过去12个月的自由现金流降至负424亿美元。2026年资本开支指引维持在2200亿美元不变。首席执行官安迪·贾西称人工智能是“一生一次的机会”。
vocab: adj. 滚动的（trailing twelve months 过去12个月）
